duo_duo_raw.dataset_description: Administrator audit logs collected from the Duo Admin API.

access_device.field_description: Details of the device used to access Duo.

application.field_description: The application related to the event.

isotimestamp.field_description: The event time in ISO 8601 format.

action.field_description: The action performed by the administrator.

object.field_description: The object the action was performed on.

timestamp.field_description: The event time as a Unix timestamp.

username.field_description: The name of the user that performed the action.

phone.field_description: The phone number related to the event.
